name: Survey tile in Aquarius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.2 degrees north of the ecliptic in Aquarius, imaged by SPHEREx 16 times in 6 visits over 69 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 29 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.9 days starting 2025-11-17, at wavelengths from 0.82 to 4.98 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
